target: STALKER 2.1 verified non-quest world loot removals

scope.loot.worldDetectors: Remove audited non-quest direct detector pickups and the protected-route X16 ordinary stash Bear; traders/quest/NPC equipment stay.
scope.loot.worldArmorRemoved: Remove audited ordinary non-quest loose suits and helmets and six eligible stash helmet entries; quest and trader/NPC gear stay.
scope.loot.looseArtifactsRemoved: Remove fixed non-quest Weird artifact world spots and DLC WaterDrip; anomaly field spawners and quest artifacts stay.

Anomaly Runner.intent: Keep detector finds and fixed Weird artifacts for field exploration; ordinary loose armor is a purchasable/earned upgrade.

Field Medic.intent: Medicine defines the specialization; detectors, suits, and fixed Weird freebies should be acquired from legitimate trading and reward channels.

Hardcore+.intent: Maximum eligible world-pickup scarcity while quest, traders, NPC equipment, anomaly fields and authored rewards remain.

Hardcore.intent: Close the remaining free-armor loophole; detectors and fixed Weird artifact pickups were already removed.

Immersive.intent: World armor and free detectors undermine acquisition and risk; keep fixed Weird artifact discoveries as environmental storytelling.

Mercenary.intent: A paid combat professional should buy/earn equipment instead of receiving free detectors, suits or Weird artifacts from fixed positions.

Mutant Hunter.intent: Lean on trophy sales and hunting gear purchases, not free detector/suit/Weird artifact routes; anomaly-field hunting remains possible.

Outcast.intent: Remove non-quest fixed Weird artifacts as well as already scarce detectors and armor: extreme outsider hardship.

Scavenger.intent: Leave worn loose armor and unusual world discoveries to support scavenging; ordinary free detectors stay removed.

Smuggler.intent: Profit from artifact trading and cargo rather than free suits; keep fixed artifact finds available while removing loose detectors.

Tactical.intent: Resource discipline and earned combat gear: no convenient non-quest detector, armor or fixed Weird artifact freebies.

Wanderer.intent: Keep detectors and fixed Weird discoveries for long-haul exploration; make loose suits a deliberate reward or trade purchase.

invariants: 12 profiles retain all 452 sourced values, preserved references and medical timing.
Only Field Medic bandages restore HP (10 HP); every other profile restores 0 HP.
Anomaly Runner and Wanderer keep loose detectors and fixed Weird artifacts; Scavenger keeps scavenged armor.
Universal artifact fields and quest, trade, NPC and reward item sources are never removed by these toggles.
The existing UI and writer remain unchanged; in-game loot spawn behavior needs fresh-game verification.
